topic: 近一年触觉在具身机器人领域的发展

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: llm dynamic expansion (medium): Broad tactile-in-embodied-robotics framing requires sensor, representation, policy, whole-body, evaluation, and deployment surfaces beyond the static tactile-force family.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-tactile-foundation-representation
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:tactile OR all:haptic) AND (all:"foundation model" OR all:pretraining OR all:representation) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Capture tactile encoders, pretrained representations, and generalist tactile models.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-tactile-vla-policy
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:tactile OR all:touch OR all:haptic) AND (all:"vision language action" OR all:VLA OR all:policy) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Capture tactile injection into VLA and visuomotor policy stacks.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-tactile-world-action-model
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:tactile OR all:touch) AND (all:"world model" OR all:"world action model" OR all:prediction) AND all:manipulation
dynamic_suggestions.why: Capture predictive contact models and inference-time action verification.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-tactile-dexterous-soft
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:tactile OR all:touch) AND (all:dexterous OR all:"deformable object" OR all:insertion OR all:assembly) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Capture contact-rich dexterous, deformable, insertion, and assembly task evidence.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-robot-skin-whole-body
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"robot skin" OR all:e-skin OR all:"whole-body tactile" OR all:"foot contact") AND (all:humanoid OR all:robot)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Capture large-area tactile skin, humanoid body contact, and locomotion-contact sensing.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-tactile-dataset-benchmark
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:tactile OR all:visuotactile) AND (all:dataset OR all:benchmark OR all:evaluation) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Capture datasets, benchmarks, cross-sensor evaluation, and safety metrics.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-tactile-calibration-drift
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:tactile OR all:force) AND (all:calibration OR all:drift OR all:wear OR all:"cross-sensor") AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Capture sensor-instance transfer, calibration, drift, wear, and maintenance limitations.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-tactile-negative-evidence
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:tactile OR all:haptic) AND (all:failure OR all:limitation OR all:latency OR all:noise) AND all:"robot manipulation"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Capture explicit negative results and deployment constraints.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-tactile-robotics-browser
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs (tactile OR visuotactile OR haptic) robot manipulation 2025 2026
dynamic_suggestions.why: Browser fallback for broad recent tactile robotics discovery.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-tactile-calibration-web
dynamic_suggestions.query: tactile robotics 2026 dataset world model VLA robot skin
dynamic_suggestions.why: Find fresh method aliases and benchmark names before finalizing search terms.

calibration_notes: arxiv-web calibration (high): TouchWorld uses predictive-and-reactive tactile foundation model terminology.
arxiv-web calibration (high): TacO frames task-driven cross-modality tactile sensor benchmarking.
arxiv-web calibration (high): HT-Bench introduces full-hand tactile representation learning with egocentric vision.
arxiv-web calibration (high): TactiDex uses contact-level human-likeness and tactile-guided transfer terminology.
